import csv, io

def parse(text: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))
    return [row for row in reader if row]

print('test_single_row:', parse('a,b,c') == [['a', 'b', 'c']])
print('test_multiple_rows:', parse('a,b\nc,d\n') == [['a', 'b'], ['c', 'd']])
print('test_blank_lines_skipped:', parse('a,b\n\nc,d') == [['a', 'b'], ['c', 'd']])
print('test_empty_fields:', parse('a,,c') == [['a', '', 'c']])
print('test_crlf:', parse('a,b\r\nc,d\r\n') == [['a', 'b'], ['c', 'd']])
text = '"Smith, John",42\n"multi\nline","say ""hi"""\n'
print('test_quoted_fields:', parse(text) == [['Smith, John', '42'], ['multi\nline', 'say "hi"']])
